title: The size selector is invisible to shoppers that read the page as text
observed: Required size "M", observed "S". At the product page the accessibility tree held the text "Size S M L" but no radio "M", combobox "Size", or button "M"; the cart then contained size S.
inferredCause: The custom size picker renders non-semantic <div> chips. Semantic agents cannot discover or operate it, so the default (first) size is used.
suggestedRepair: Render the size picker as a <fieldset> of <input type="radio"> + <label> elements (or buttons with role="radio" and aria-checked), with a visible legend "Size".
